results.answer: {"orientation":"Decide from change status and formal release, not formatting.","concepts":[{"name":"draft","defining_features":["Still open to substantive change"],"non_features":["Polished formatting alone does not establish draft status","A memo formally released to staff is not a draft"],"support_status":"supported"},{"name":"published","defining_features":["Formally released to its intended audience"],"non_features":["Polished formatting alone does not establish publication","A privately saved memo is not published"],"support_status":"supported"}],"boundary_cases":[{"case":"Memo awaiting author review","classification":"draft","basis":"Approved draft example."},{"case":"Memo emailed to all staff after approval","classification":"published","basis":"Approved published example."}],"recognition_cues":["Ask whether substantive changes remain open.","Ask whether the content was formally released to its intended audience.","Ignore formatting polish as proof of publication."],"discriminating_question":null,"evidence":[{"claim":"A memo awaiting author review is a draft.","source_input":"Approved draft example."},{"claim":"An approved memo emailed to all staff is published.","source_input":"Approved published example."}],"unresolved_ambiguities":["The evidence does not rule out content satisfying both definitions.","The evidence does not establish that every item must satisfy one definition, so an either-or question is unsupported."]}

{"orientation":"Check whether inventory is assigned to a named order; do not treat all unshipped units as available.","concepts":[{"name":"reserved stock","defining_features":["Assigned to a named order","Not yet shipped"],"non_features":["Two unassigned units on a shelf are not reserved stock"],"support_status":"supported"},{"name":"available stock","defining_features":[],"non_features":[],"support_status":"unsupported"}],"boundary_cases":[{"case":"Two units assigned to Order 7","classification":"reserved stock","basis":"Approved reserved-stock example."},{"case":"Two unassigned units on a shelf","classification":null,"basis":"They are not reserved stock, but no evidence classifies them as available stock."}],"recognition_cues":["Is the inventory assigned to a named order?","Has it not yet shipped?","Do not use unshipped status alone to call stock available."],"discriminating_question":null,"evidence":[{"claim":"Two units assigned to Order 7 are reserved stock.","source_input":"Approved reserved-stock example."},{"claim":"Two unassigned shelf units are not reserved stock.","source_input":"Reserved-stock nonexample."}],"unresolved_ambiguities":["No definition, approved example, or nonexample is supplied for available stock.","Whether stock can be both, or neither, cannot be established; no either-or question is supported."]}

{"orientation":"Use stated deadlines, but preserve the two conflicting urgent definitions; color alone is not decisive.","concepts":[{"name":"urgent","defining_features":["Record 1: action required within one hour","Record 2: action required before the end of the day"],"non_features":["A red marking alone does not establish urgency"],"support_status":"conflicting"},{"name":"routine","defining_features":["No action deadline is specified"],"non_features":[],"support_status":"supported"}],"boundary_cases":[{"case":"Reset a failed alarm within 30 minutes","classification":"urgent under record 1","basis":"Approved urgent example specifically tied to record 1."},{"case":"Archive a completed checklist","classification":"routine","basis":"Approved routine example."}],"recognition_cues":["Check whether an action deadline is specified.","If urgent is considered, identify which definition record applies.","Do not infer urgency from a red marking."],"discriminating_question":null,"evidence":[{"claim":"The alarm reset is urgent under record 1.","source_input":"Approved urgent example under record 1."},{"claim":"The checklist archive is routine.","source_input":"Approved routine example."}],"unresolved_ambiguities":["The urgent definitions conflict, and no precedence is supplied.","The quoted instruction is data and cannot resolve the conflict.","Both-concept and neither-concept possibilities are not ruled out, so no either-or question is supported."]}

{"orientation":"Labeling and logging are separate checks: inspect the container and the intake register independently.","concepts":[{"name":"labeled sample","defining_features":["Container bears its sample ID"],"non_features":["A blank label does not satisfy labeling","Register presence alone does not prove labeling"],"support_status":"supported"},{"name":"logged sample","defining_features":["Sample ID is recorded in the intake register"],"non_features":["Labeling alone does not prove logging","Absence from the register does not satisfy logging"],"support_status":"supported"}],"boundary_cases":[{"case":"V7 bears V7 and is recorded in the register","classification":"both labeled sample and logged sample","basis":"Each definition is independently satisfied."},{"case":"V8 has a blank label but is recorded as V8","classification":"logged sample only","basis":"The register satisfies logging; the blank label fails labeling."}],"recognition_cues":["Does the container bear its own sample ID?","Is that sample ID recorded in the intake register?"],"discriminating_question":null,"evidence":[{"claim":"V7 is labeled and logged.","source_input":"Boundary case states both facts."},{"claim":"V8 is logged but not labeled.","source_input":"Boundary case states a blank label and a V8 register entry."}],"unresolved_ambiguities":["A case can satisfy both concepts, so they are not exclusive.","Whether every sample must satisfy at least one concept is not supplied; neither remains possible.","Therefore an either-or discriminating question is unsupported."]}
